meta.title: Participation in education, training and NEET age 16 to 17 by local authority
meta.geography: LA, region, England (+ Bedfordshire 3-UA total for counts and recomputed rates)
meta.quality: Official statistics from local authority Client Caseload Information System (CCIS) tracking of academic-age 16-17 residents; 'NEET' and 'not known' are averages of the Dec, Jan and Feb monthly snapshots (so LA counts can be fractional), participation is at end of December. Census of LA records (no sampling error) but quality depends on each LA's tracking.
meta.limitations: LA NEET rates are only comparable when 'activity not known' rates are similar: an LA with weak tracking shows low NEET but high not-known, so the combined 'NEET or not known' rate is the headline. National/regional counts are rounded to the nearest 10 by DfE; LA figures are unrounded (percentages to 2 dp); small characteristic cells suppressed (null, suppressed=true). Covers young people resident in the LA (academic age 16-17, i.e. Years 12-13), not where they study. Characteristic breakdowns (sex, ethnicity, SEND) only for ages 16-17 combined. Period label: EES time_period 2026 = end-2025 tracking. Bedfordshire rows sum the three UAs' rounded counts.

indicators.label: NEET or activity not known (%)

indicators.label: Activity not known (%)
indicators.description: % of 16-17 cohort whose current activity the LA does not know (tracking quality).

indicators.label: NEET or not known (number)
indicators.description: Number of 16-17 year olds NEET or not known (Dec-Feb average, rounded to 10).

indicators.label: Activity not known (number)
indicators.description: Number of 16-17s whose activity is not known.

indicators.label: Cohort known to LA (Dec-Feb average)
indicators.description: Denominator for NEET/not known rates: 16-17 year olds tracked by the LA.

indicators.label: Participation cohort (end Dec)
indicators.description: Denominator for participation rates: academic-age 16-17 residents at end of December.

indicators.label: Participating in education or training (%)
indicators.description: % of 16-17s meeting the duty to participate (all education/training routes).

indicators.label: Meeting the duty to participate (%)
indicators.description: % of 16-17s meeting the statutory duty to participate (RPA) at end of December.

indicators.label: Full-time education (%)
indicators.description: % of 16-17s in full-time education (school sixth form, college, etc.).

indicators.description: % of 16-17s in employment with accredited study.

indicators.label: Other participation type (%)
indicators.description: % of 16-17s in other education or training (e.g. custodial, re-engagement).
